queries.name: columns
queries.sql: SELECT n.nspname AS table_schema,c.relname AS table_name,a.attname AS column_name,pg_catalog.format_type(a.atttypid,a.atttypmod) AS data_type,pg_catalog.col_description(c.oid,a.attnum) AS column_comment,pg_catalog.obj_description(c.oid,'pg_class') AS table_comment FROM pg_catalog.pg_class c JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace JOIN pg_catalog.pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid=c.oid WHERE n.nspname=ANY(%s) AND c.relname=ANY(%s) AND a.attnum>0 AND NOT a.attisdropped ORDER BY n.nspname,c.relname,a.attnum LIMIT 201
